newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-TURKISH CUP MATCH ENDS IN BRAWL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TURKISH CUP MATCH ENDS IN BRAWL.

text.p: A Turkish cup soccer match in Istanbul ended in chaos when fighting broke out between players, police, club officials and fans after home team Besiktas were knocked out of the competition.
Four rival players from Besiktas and fellow first division side Kocaelispor exchanged insults and blows at the end of Tuesday night's game, Anatolian news agency said.
Besiktas official Kadir Akbulut and some supporters then joined the brawl before police escorted the group from the pitch, the agency said.

Fighting continued into the changing rooms, with Akbulut grabbing Kocaelispor goalkeeper Dimitri Stingaciu around the throat. Besiktas director Erdal Acar was struck by police in the ensuing struggle, Anatolian said.
A bus carrying Kocaelispor fans was stoned and one fan was stabbed in the leg as he attempted to board the bus.
Besiktas won the game 2-1 but were eliminated on the away goals rule after losing the first leg in Kocaeli 1-0.
